meta.method: per-exposure circular aperture on the L2 image (MJy/sr x pixel solid angle), sigma-clipped annulus background; flagged = any non-informational FLAGS bit in the aperture (e.g. saturated core), err from VARIANCE (or annulus scatter) + background error; saturated = OVERFLOW/NONLINEAR/BLOOM in the aperture: the flux is a lower limit, keep flagged points out of light curves
